title: ACMP - Another Cobblemon Modpack
description: This is another one of those things.
body:
# Yet Another Cobblemon Pack



```
Oh, god. Another one of these things?!
```




so, here's the gist.
- Tech Mods
  - You know the deal. Automate making your pokeballs, store nearly endless amounts of crap in Applied Energistics, maybe see about making more than that?
- Cobblemon
   - You know? The whole thing this modpack is based around? Catch'em all, dude.
   - Oh, and uh… some pokemon got too close to a meteor, and now really want to fight everything.
   - Not to mention, you'll be able to Terrastalize, Mega Evolve, and use Z-Moves.
- Sophisticated Backpacks
  - Gotta hold all the stuff you're gonna loot.
- Quests; because all modpacks have them, for some unknown reason.
- Probably no way to really break progression… Unless…?

You and I both know that this modpack idea isn't original; but that doesn't make it any less fun! 

You're probably going to want to bring some hyper potions, a snag machine and maybe a few other bits and pieces.

Your goal? Go find gyms to conquer; and fight the Ender Dragon while your at it. After all… This is 'Yet another cobblemon pack.'

What makes this different is that while yes, it's the usual suspects for a cobblemon pack; It's meant to throw a touch of shade at them, all while giving a bit of love to modpacks as a whole.
